name: environment_variables
task_prompt:
Write a Python script to display all environment variables from os.environ.
Group them into sections:
  [SYSTEM PATHS]  — PATH, PATHEXT, SystemRoot, WINDIR, etc.
  [USER]          — USERNAME, USERPROFILE, HOME, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA
  [TEMP]          — TEMP, TMP
  [OTHER]         — everything else, sorted alphabetically
For PATH: split by ; or : and print each entry on its own line, indented.
Print total variable count at the end.
